draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Following up on our onboarding call last week — I know getting started takes a back seat when things are busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
